items.lang|mortal_cultivation|jei.mortal_culti:
§6Cinnabar Blood Ink
§7Made with cinnabar mixed with the blood of the caster or spiritual beasts, used to draw talismans with magical patterns. The yang nature of cinnabar can suppress evil spirits.

§eUsage:§7 Used in talisman crafting, placed in a special slot in the talisman crafting table, has 20 durability.

§6Calligraphy Brush
§7A brush made from dragon peacock feathers, it can be used to draw talismans on talisman paper when dipped in cinnabar blood ink.

§eUsage:§7 Used in talisman crafting, placed in a special slot in the talisman crafting table, has 180 durability.

§6Talisman Paper
§7Specially made yellow paper, treated to hold spiritual energy and form talismans.

§eUsage:§7 Used in talisman crafting, the basic material for creating various talismans.

§6Foundation Building Pill
§7You need to consume this pill to successfully establish your foundation.

§eUsage:§7 Right-click to consume.

§6Stellar Core Pill
§7Absorbs stellar energy, providing powerful buffs: Strength III, Resistance I, and Absorption II for 3 minutes.

§eUsage:§7 Right-click to consume, 10-minute cooldown.

§6Condensed Essence Pill
§7Reduces demonic interference and helps stabilize your Nascent Soul. Provides Resistance I effect for 5 minutes.

§eUsage:§7 Right-click to consume.

§6Void Refinement Pill
§7A profound pill that allows cultivators to refine and harmonize with void energy, advancing their cultivation.

§eUsage:§7 Right-click to consume.

§6Heaven Cleansing Elixir
§7Cleanses meridians and removes impurities. Consumption purifies the body by removing accumulated toxins and impurities from the cultivator's meridian system.

§cSpecial Effect:§7 Transforms Wastelander race into Human race when consumed.

§eUsage:§7 Right-click to consume for body purification.

§6Alchemy Furnace
§7A specialized furnace designed for pill refinement. Built with copper as the main material and infused with magic ore shard power, it can precisely control heat for crafting various cultivation pills.

§eUsage:§7 Place and use to refine various pills.

Cultivation Guide

This guide covers cultivation paths, pills, talismans, ruins, rune gathering, ancient-book deciphering, and lost skills. New players should begin with Ruins & Deciphering and follow the stele, Reflection Orb, Rune Table, Scholar Table, and manual progression.

items.lang|mysticism|enchantment.mysticism.bor: Damaging your foes with this weapon causes cold, biting Permafrost to pierce their very being.
items.lang|mysticism|enchantment.mysticism.hol: Damaging your foes with this weapon causes them to burst into bright, powerful Brimstone flames.
items.lang|mysticism|gamerule.mpSkillCost.desc: Do Unique Skills cost Soul Energy on acquirement.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.amped_guit: An evolved Guitar Wolf that has a deep connection to sound. It can disrupt the magic of nearby enemies, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.ant.descri: Ants are fearless critters that have absurdly tanky exoskeletons, known for being bulky and hard to take down. Prepare for a long, drawn out battle if you encounter one!
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.antumbra_s: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Light Fangs bow to this creature.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.arch_angel: Only few Angels make it to this point because of their lack of ego.
The result of an Arch Daemon possessing a magisteel body.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.arch_falle: An arch angel that got corrupted by magicules, then chose to abandon the light for the darkness.
An evolved scorpion, with the capability of manipulating gravity itself. It floats around aimlessly and randomly stings things it finds interesting. It has never been hunted excessively due to its nature, so its defenses are extremely weak.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.ascended.d: It will be fine if you never remember your past. That is what they tell themselves. Being able to accept this truth and embrace it. That is why they Ascend past all odds to become Spiritual Lifeforms despite their challenges.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.attuned_wy: A race of wyrm that as yet to find a element to evolve into, it searches for ways to evolve while it wanders the world.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.beetle.des: Beetles are heavy-hitting insects, focusing everything into their power. Though they are one of the stronger races, their defences are lacklustre, to put it nicely.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.black_fang: A Direwolf that has a connection to magic. It can tune in to the nearby magicules and use it to sense its surroundings.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.blazing_sc: An evolved Scorch Wolf that has a deep connection to pure heat and energy. It can create deadly fire storms, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.blue_centi: An evolved centipede, leaning into its swimming ability. It loves to hunt in the vast oceans, making use of its ability to paralyze targets.
A Direwolf that has a connection to water. It can tune in to the nearby magicules and use it to sense its surroundings.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.brown_fang: A Direwolf that has a connection to the earth. It can tune in to the nearby magicules and use it to sense its surroundings.
Centipedes are fast, speed-oriented insects that can escape virtually any fight. Their many legs makes up for their lack of power.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.chaos_doll: The result of an Arch Doll reversing its alignment to become Chaos aligned.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.chaos_meta: The result of a Chaos Doll  achieving Divinity and awakening.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.charged_pe: A rare mutation of a sculk worm. It consumed essence of Lightning itself and gained specific abilities. But this one... Seems weird.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.cherub.des: The second most powerful type of pure Angel known.
